text: Rise... Ankhu. Your voice has come back to you, Ankhu. Here, words are the only hands you have. Water listens to a direction.

designed.name: Q1_rolling_ancient
designed.description: An ancient god of the dead. Very deep, gravelly, husky bass, slow and hushed, enormous gravitas. An unusual old-world accent that belongs to no living country: rolled r's, long open vowels, consonants pressed forward, a faint lilt at the ends of phrases. Voice only: no background sound, no music, no sound effects, no echo, no room ambience. Clean studio recording, completely dry.
